content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lexington

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours-of-experience thresholds for the PMP credential. Granite PM Academy staff can help you assess whether your background meets these requirements before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Lexington-focused cohorts deliver the PMI-mandated contact hours over an intensive schedule. Learn from certified instructors, interact with peers, and build the knowledge foundation the exam demands.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the Boot Camp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of your 35 contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay the PMI examination fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study materials to solidify your readiness. Schedule your PMP exam at an authorized testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer questions during your final preparation phase.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Once certified, maintain your PMP by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing education and PDU-eligible courses to support your continuous professional growth and credential renewal.
